name: lq1784_rotate_actionable_20261110
comment: ANCHOR: LQ1784_ROTATE_ACTIONABLE_20261110 - the Home CIO rotate column (operator complaint, P0). D1: the
constituent floors (price >= $5.00, 20-session average dollar volume >= $10M, |RS20| <= 100 dropped and counted, a
>5% same-session split disagreement) drop what the operator cannot trade, while a HELD name stays listed with a
plain flag and the drops are counted per group. D2: one action line per group, one line per stock (symbol, held
flag, price, stronger/weaker than the ETF by N pts), a next tranche for a filled one, and a time-aware event line
so a release that has already printed is never the next event. Hermetic: synthetic fixtures and an injected
read-only db_query; no live store is read.
